QEVA LEARNING CORE 1 — independent teaching overlays
Site release 0.4.0; archive protocol remains 0.2.

The permanent mathematical record and its verification label are not a learner state.
Teaching may refer to exact archive revisions, but cannot rewrite them.

IDENTITY
Profiles: qeva:learning:<slug>@<positive revision>
Activities: qeva:activity:<slug>@<positive revision>
Routes: qeva:route:<slug>@<positive revision>
Archive targets: qeva:1:<slug>@<positive revision>
JSON schema_version identifies the interpretation rules, not the current website.

A profile declares archive target, difficulty, pedagogical prerequisites and reasons,
related archive concepts, layered explanations, activity refs and two sets of required
activities: understood and mastered. A prerequisite names an exact profile and a
minimum state of understood or mastered. The prerequisite graph must have no cycle.
Routes declare goals; the interpreter computes the prerequisite closure.

STATES
locked: a prerequisite is unmet; reading and experiments are still permitted.
available: prerequisites met, no discovery/attempt yet.
discovered: visited, no attempt.
learning: response evidence exists but core checks incomplete.
understood: every core activity has a passing response under its exact revision.
mastered: core and transfer requirements met; not a credential or external assessment.
Earlier failures remain. Later failures do not erase earlier evidence in format 1.

EVIDENCE
qeva-learner/1 stores discoveries, attempts and preferences, not authoritative states.
An attempt contains id, activity_ref, at (ISO timestamp), response.
Known responses are rechecked; unknown revisions are retained without awarding credit.
Merge deduplicates identical IDs and rejects conflicting content under one ID.
Imported progress is untrusted self-report, never archive verification.

ACTIVITIES
number: finite decimal within declared tolerance.
choice: selected option ID.
classification: label ID per item.
order: exact ordered step IDs.
experiment: declared versioned kernel, valid run parameters, fixed values unchanged,
required distinct comparisons and an interpretation response.
Static HTML includes prompts, hints and answer scopes. JavaScript is an enhancement.

PRESERVATION
Use independent UTF-8 JSON records and exact refs; publish changed content as a new
revision. A bundle is replaceable transport. Do not depend on accounts for reading.
See learning-*.schema.json, activity.schema.json, learner-state.schema.json and
../docs/LEARNING_ENGINE.md for full fields and local implementation limits.
